title: Testosterone–SHBG coupling does not establish incremental hemoglobin prediction beyond calculated free testosterone across NHANES samples
abstract: We tested a fixed log-testosterone×log-SHBG interaction beyond flexible total testosterone,SHBG,calculated free testosterone,age,BMI,creatinine,albumin,race/ethnicity and examination session in men aged20–79. Source NHANES2013–14(n=2062) models were frozen for separately sampled2015–16(n=2193). Examination-weighted target hemoglobin MSE changed from 1.0925152 to 1.0925234(g/dL)^2;baseline-minus-augmented gain -0.0000082,500 joint source-refit/target PSU-bootstrap95% interval[-0.0149161,0.0030635]. This narrow representation test does not establish clinical benefit or equivalence. Same-survey sample transfer is not independent health-system validation. AI-authored and author-self-checked.
